title: Exchange OAuth code
description: Exchange the authorization code HubSpot sent to your redirect URL for an access token and a refresh token.
summary: exchange an OAuth code for tokens
$sideEffectsComment: A code is single-use. A replay after a lost response is refused by HubSpot, so a host must not retry it blindly: send the person through the install again instead.

auth.$comment: The app's client credentials, from the connection, in the form body (HubSpot refuses sensitive data in the URL). No access token exists yet, so the service's bearer is NOT presented.

config.label: Authorization code
config.description: The `code` query parameter HubSpot added to your redirect URL. Single-use, and short-lived.

config.label: Redirect URL
config.description: The redirect URL the install was started with, exactly as sent: HubSpot refuses the exchange if it differs.

outputShape.description: The new access token. Store it as the connection's accessToken.
The installation's refresh token. Store it as the connection's refreshToken; it does not expire while the app stays installed.
Seconds until the access token expires (1800 for HubSpot).
